about: The magnificent Silver Bridge connects the states of Ohio and West Virginia between Point Pleasant, West Virginia and Kanauga, Ohio. Built in 1928 the bridge was of unusual I-Beam construction, one of three in the world. On December 15, 1967 the bridge collapsed carrying and estimated 80 persons to death in the Ohio River.
